steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Nng...

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Where am I...?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Argh—!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: (So dizzy...! But I can see... and hear.)

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: (I can't feel... my ankle.)

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: (It's so quiet. Where did everyone go?)

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: (Silent as the grave... Did the rioters just leave me here?)

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: You're awake.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Aaah?!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Calm down.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Oh, sorry! You startled me.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Huh? You... I know you. You're from Rhodes Island.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: GreyThroat, Operator.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Keep your voice down. We took care of the rebels in this area.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Took care of them...?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Even at this point, you still don't see them as the enemy.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Relax, most of them are still alive. Handed over to Officer Severin Hawthorn.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: ...Thanks.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Oh, um... What about Miss Folinic?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: She's fine. I sent another operator to help her. But...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Did Atro really... sacrifice herself?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: ...Yes. I'm sorry.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: That explains the way Folinic has been acting...

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Just a few operators won't be able to retake this neighborhood on their own. We should fall back to the town center and regroup.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Right. Can you walk? You injured your ankle.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I... I can try. Ow...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Here, let me help.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Thanks...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: One more question, Miss Tatjana. When I came here with Atro, Wolumonde was still thriving.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: So what happened to all the Gendarmerie? There isn't a single one left in town.

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Hng!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Put down your weapon. Look at yourself. You don't even have a decent set of clothes. You're going to fight like that?

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: What do you outsiders know? What do you even get out of helping those noble puppets?!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Nothing. I'm not interested in your politics at all. But... are you a Winterwisp?

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Winterwisp...? Hah. I'm not aboriginal, but I do acknowledge their struggle!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: How about you? Dr. Atro was a good person, but you? You're just here to help them crush us!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Wolumonde, no, all of Leithanien is rotten to the core! Today they burn the Infected alive, tomorrow it will be the entire working class!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Where's your proof?

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: There's not a single Gendarmerie in Wolumonde! Not one!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Why do you think that is?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Wolumonde and several surrounding towns formed a collective settlement network. When the Catastrophe struck, there were not enough Gendarmerie to care for all of the—

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Oh really? If it was that simple, nobody would mind!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Enough stalling. Out with it.

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: For a wedding.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: A wedding?

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Some great nobleman in his high tower married the only daughter of another nobleman, so they sent all the Gendarmerie over to the nearest nomadic city!

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: And how long do you think the aristocrats' drunken revelries are gonna last? You wanna guess?

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Oh and I almost forgot about the part where the nobles argued back and forth for a month about whose city should move to whose territory.

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: So our Gendarmerie had to go stand around some fancy mansions to boost a fortunate son's ego, and maybe keep out the riffraff. Isn't that funny? Are you laughing?

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Because I'm not.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No, it's not funny. But that still doesn't give me any leads as to the fire.

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: Think about it: who's going to set fire to a medical camp that treats Infected? Would the Infected do that?

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: It could only be someone who wants to see the Infected suffer. You should be on our side—

steps.name: Rebellious Townsfolk
steps.text: —The side of Reunion!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Schultz! The rebels refuse to surrender!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: There aren't many of them...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: The truly horrific thing about this disaster is that both sides are ordinary civilians. There are no warriors here.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: We should do everything we can to avoid the worst case scenario.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: GreyThroat! Miss Tatjana! You're back!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: And we're going to make the murderer pay for their crimes.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Tatjana!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Uncle... I'm sorry. I was careless...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: No... All that matters is that you're safe.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Operator Folinic. Glad to see you safe and sound.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: GreyThroat, I recall it was you who came with Atro to Wolumonde?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Do you know what happened?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: ...I've got the gist of it.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Do you think... If you were with her, that things would've turned out differently?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Folinic, you shouldn't—

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: No. The myriad contradictions this crisis has revealed in Wolumonde can't be solved by external forces. There is nothing we could've done.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: But at least... I should have been there with her, to do what I could.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I'm sorry. I'm sorry I wasn't with her.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No... *Sigh*. It was wrong of me to push that on you just to make myself feel better. What the hell am I doing...?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'm the one who should be sorry.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: People.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Let me start by offering my sincere thanks to Rhodes Island for saving Tatjana.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Rhodes Island is an organization dedicated to helping the Infected.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Severin Hawthorn, Leithanien is known for its lenient treatment of the Infected. But I still have to ask, before we get down to business—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: On behalf of Wolumonde, can you guarantee that Wolumonde has not, in light of these exceptional circumstances, taken 'additional measures' against the Infected population?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: The investigations you carried out with Miss Suzuran should have corroborated this.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Wolumonde has in no way, at no point, targeted the Infected. Nor have we ever held ill will toward Dr. Atro, who aided the Infected.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Are you satisfied?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Miss Folinic, I believe Mr. Severin.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Um... well... I'm not sure! But I do believe him! He wouldn't hurt Infected people!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Okay, Lisa. I'll trust your instincts, for now.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Thank you for understanding.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Now, I'd like to hear your opinions on what to do next.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I'm not as familiar with the field as Folinic. I followed her instructions during the operation.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: There aren't a lot of them out there.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Counting those we have successfully subdued, there can't be more than a hundred or so.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: A hundred or so rioters wouldn't be able to terrorize Wolumonde under normal circumstances.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: As for the Gendarmerie, I've heard some interesting rumors.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: That was one of the very few unfortunate decisions I've made in my military career. We can't do anything about it, so let's shelve it for now.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Allow me to interject. I'd like to discuss that captive, who called himself 'Reunion.'

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: We have made contact with a certain lone member of the Reunion Movement, and he has very little in common with the outraged citizenry.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: He's a battle-hardened warrior. And if he came with a squad, he could be a problem.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: The partisans. This is not good news.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Reunion...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Chernobog... Ursus... Gah... Not Ursus again...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Why should I believe a single word they say?!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: The fire was the trigger for all of this. But there was always a high risk of conflict.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Did these underlying problems cause the fire? Or was this fire the catalyst that revealed these problems?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Do we have a choice...? Do we have to fight?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: This is the choice that decides the fate of Wolumonde. Thousands of lives hang in the balance. We can't be hasty.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: We should return to the Rathaus for a formal resolution.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Hm. But it looks like the other side won't give us the chance.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: If Reunion really is here, there's no need for a light touch.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Roger that. However, Folinic, you should stay here and tend to the wounded.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'd rather get in there my—

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Lisa, Operator Suzuran, is not a fully accredited medic operator. Only you are.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: You should prioritize protecting the innocent over defeating the enemy.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Miss Folinic... You should stay here.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: If you keep fighting that hard, that aggressively, you won't be you anymore.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Right... okay. I'll... stay.
